name: 1-cover.jpg
description: Golden hour on the Playa Dorada avenue: the hero coupe parked in the lower third with the driver's arm on the sill, the character leaning a clear step off its flank, pedestrians on both pavements and traffic receding down the middle distance.

name: 2-chase.jpg
description: A four-star pursuit seen from the kerb: the hero coupe running down the avenue, three cruisers closing around it, the helicopter's searchlight over the rooftops, and two police trucks nose-to-nose with a striped barrier across the junction ahead.

name: 3-mission.jpg
description: The marina fish market during a firefight: the player aiming a pistol in the lower third, the crew and stall-holders scattered between the stalls, boats and gulls behind them.

name: 4-night.jpg
description: The same avenue after dark: the hero coupe under a lamp pool, neon blades on both facades, and lit towers stepping back into the sea fog.
